name: Unknown
description: This is an unknown trigger, possibly from a newer version; it will not work in this version.

name: OnObjectEnter
description: The script will be run after the selected object becomes the active object.

name: OnObjectValidate
description: The script will be run before internal validation when an attempt is made to exit the selected object.

name: OnObjectExit
description: The script will be run when an attempt is made to exit the active selected object.

name: OnObjectModify
description: The script will be run after the selected object is modified when active.

name: OnObjectSave
description: The script will be run after changes to the selected active object are validated and saved.

name: OnObjectKeystroke
description: The script will be run when a keystroke is received for the active selected object.

name: OnPanelSwitch
description: The script will be run before panel is switched.

name: OnObjectAVPlayerChange
description: The script will be run when the layout object AV Player changes state.

name: OnLayoutEnter
description: The script will be run after this layout is loaded.

name: OnLayoutExit
description: The script will be run before this layout is exited.

name: OnLayoutKeystroke
description: The script will be run when a keystroke is received on this layout or any object on this layout if it is not handled by an OnObjectKeystroke script.

name: OnRecordLoad
description: The script will be run after any record is made current on this layout.

name: OnRecordCommit
description: The script will be run when an attempt is made to commit record changes on this layout.

name: OnRecordRevert
description: The script will be run when an attempt is made to revert record changes on this layout.

name: OnModeEnter
description: The script will be run after entering a new mode on this layout.

name: OnModeExit
description: The script will be run when an attempt is made to exit the current mode on this layout.

name: OnViewChange
description: The script will be run after switching to Form, List, or Table view in this layout.

name: OnLayoutSizeChange
description: The script will be run after the layout has been resized.

name: OnGestureTap
description: The script will be run when a tap gesture is received on this layout.

name: OnExternalCommandReceived
description: The script will be run when an external command is received.

name: OnFirstWindowOpen
description: The script will be run after the first window of a file is opened.

name: OnLastWindowClose
description: The script will be run before the last window of a file is closed.

name: OnWindowOpen
description: The script will be run after a window is opened.

name: OnWindowClose
description: The script will be run before a window is closed.

name: OnFileAVPlayerChange
description: The script will be run when the field or URL AV Player changes state.

name: OnWindowTransaction
description: The script will be run after a transaction is successfully committed.
